heading.title: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article48Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part II—Suits Relating to Contracts
For contribution by a party who has paid the whole or more than his share of the amount due under a joint decree, or by a sharer in a joint estate who has paid the whole or more than his share of the amount of revenue due from himself and his co-sharers.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of the payment in excess of the plaintiff’s own share.
